d: Connor McDavid, Macklin Celebrini, Brady Tkachuk, David Pastrnak and more take on NASCAR racing simulators, sharing their biggest driving pet peeves, rating their teammates behind the wheel and discovering racing is harder than it looks. NHL stars include Cole Caufield, Tage Thompson, Matthew Schaefer, Aleksander Barkov, Jamie Drysdale, Tom Wilson, Jake Sanderson, Jaccob Slavin, Jake Guentzel, Trevor Zegras, and Pavel Dorofeyev.
